scheme_name: Assistance to Farmers to Purchase Heavy Farm Equipment (Tractor)
other_conditions: The tractor must be purchased from an authorized dealer
Only one tractor component can be claimed per land record (8‑A)
If multiple farmers are listed on the same land record, only one farmer will receive the benefit
A farmer can claim the benefit on only one land record, even if they appear on multiple records
The benefit can be availed once every 10 years per land record
benefits_summary: Provides a 25% subsidy on tractor purchase – up to ₹45,000 for models up to 40 PTO HP and up to ₹60,000 for models between 40 PTO HP and 60 PTO HP.
